# KAMROK

> Web design, branding and online stores built end to end by a small Dundalk, Ireland studio (Candy Shop Digital Ltd). WordPress, Shopify and custom sites.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kamrok.com/): Interactive studio portfolio.
- [About](https://kamrok.com/about): The team — Cormac McCann and Kayla Minto.
- [Work](https://kamrok.com/work): Selected client work and case studies.
- [Skills](https://kamrok.com/skills): Technologies and services we offer.
- [Blog](https://kamrok.com/blog): Articles and notes.
- [Contact](https://kamrok.com/contact): Start a project.
- [Free tools](https://kamrok.com/tools): Free business and marketing tools.

## Case studies

- [Clubrovia](https://kamrok.com/work/clubrovia): Club operating system, our own product.
- [McKevitt's Village Hotel](https://kamrok.com/work/mckevitts): Brand and website for a Carlingford hotel.
